chunks: And certainly, mockery was made of apostles before you; so I allowed the disbelievers respite, then I seized them. So how was the consequence of My punishment?
ai.seo_question: How did God treat the prophets who were mocked by their people?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of 'Imla' (divine respite), where God grants the disbelievers time to accumulate their sins before delivering a decisive punishment, serving as a comfort to the Prophet Muhammad and his followers. It highlights the historical precedent of earlier prophets facing ridicule, reinforcing the inevitability of divine justice and the temporary nature of worldly power for the mockers.
